BSUPA Ready to Ride Course

The BSUPA Level 1 “Ready to Ride” course is aimed at beginners, or if you would like a refresher on basic sup techniques and rescues. Learning to paddle board is a fast and fun process with a qualified BSUPA instructor.

The course structure is designed to give you the information you need to get on the water safely, have fun and learn the techniques of paddleboarding.

During the course you will be given an introduction to:

  • SUP and Safety equipment
  • How to carry the paddleboard and paddle
  • Paddling technique
  • Different types of turns
  • Water safety and self rescue
  • How the weather and environment affects you

The 2 hour course is run on flat water. The cost of the course includes hire of:

  • Board
  • Paddle
  • Wetsuit
  • Buoyancy aid

What to bring

  • A Towel
  • Swimwear (for under the wetsuit)
  • An old pair of trainers or gym shoes, that you don’t mind getting wet
  • Warm clothing to change back into afterwards
  • Money/Card for the Cafe if you fancy a tea/coffee afterwards

Once proficient in paddling and self rescue you can book onto our Social Paddles or Performance Paddling Group Sessions.
